title: Data Visualization and Charting

useCases.title: Render chart widget from query results
preconditions: Chart widget is configured with data source
mainFlow: 3. System transforms query results to chart data format
4. System renders chart (Bar, Line, Pie, or Custom)
5. Chart displays with legend and axis labels
6. User can hover over chart elements for details
7. User can optionally filter or drill down
alternateFlows: 2a. Query returns no results — system displays empty state message
2b. Query fails — system displays error message

useCases.title: Render table widget from query results
preconditions: Table widget is configured with data source
postconditions: Table is rendered with paginated data
mainFlow: 3. System displays data in table format with columns from query
4. System applies pagination (20 rows per page)

useCases.title: Render metric widget
postconditions: Metric value is displayed with optional sparkline
mainFlow: 3. System displays value in large prominent format
5. System optionally displays sparkline of historical values

domainEntities.name: ChartConfig
domainEntities.persistenceRationale: Configuration is stored as part of widget instance

microflows.name: ACT_Chart_Render
microflows.trigger: Dashboard page load or widget refresh

microflows.name: ACT_Query_Execute
microflows.trigger: Chart rendering, table pagination, metric refresh

microflows.name: ACT_DataTransform_ToChart
microflows.trigger: After query execution for chart widgets

buildComposition.chart: Bar/Line/Pie/Custom chart with legend and title

buildComposition.table: Paginated data table with sortable columns

buildComposition.metric: Large value display with optional sparkline and trend
buildComposition.label: Metric name and unit

security.model: Viewers can see charts/tables but cannot modify queries or data sources

crossCuttingRequirements: Charts must render within 2 seconds for <10k data points
Table pagination must work smoothly for large datasets (>100k rows)
All data queries must sanitize inputs to prevent SQL injection
Chart colors must be accessible (WCAG AA color contrast)
Metrics must refresh at configurable intervals (minimum 1 minute)
